newsitem.title: USA: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent lower.
newsitem.headline: NYCE cotton called to open 0.10 cent lower.

text.p: NYCE cotton futures were called to open 0.10 cent a lb weaker on Wednesday, based on market orders at 1018 EDT, dealers said.

Speculative short-covering should support prices around current levels, ahead of the first notice day for July cotton on June 24. But the trade is likely to remain a steady scale-up seller, dealers said.
Tuesday, the new-crop December contract settled at 75.64 cents a lb, up 0.71 cent. Spot July ended up 0.42 at 72.66 cents.
Support in July pegged at 72.00 cents, and technical resistance remained at the recent high of 73.90 cents in July.
